purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The municipal manual describes SIGETUX 2.0 as a public interactive GIS for municipal planning, data, metadata and photogrammetry. State directory lists a Tuxtla registral delegation; municipal pages provide predial and property-transfer workflows. No cadastral parcel layer or full-polygon schema was confirmed.
registryAssessment: The official Chiapas Institute Registral directory lists Delegación Registral Tuxtla 1 in the city, while the municipal government provides property-tax and urban-property procedures. This confirms local property/cadastral administration, but no anonymous parcel geometry service was verified.
